evidence.what: Integrated baseline run: 1,500 CRC + 600 cervical loops, noisy reviewer, process + NATS kills
evidence.result: CRC precision 1.000, recall 0.948, **0/563 false closures**. 0 duplicates or losses. Tamper 17/17 detected. Forged events 0/24 with effect. 0 wrong-patient sends.
evidence.label: simulated

evidence.what: **Frozen final evaluation**: 5 seeds × 2 noise models; v2 is an independent corruption model never used for training or tuning; 6,314 index loops per run across seven programme types from every held-out person
evidence.result: Held-out v2 noise (code `075abc5`): CRC P 1.000, R 0.785 (0.772–0.798), **0/3,035 false closures**; cervical 0/1,303, lung 0/1,907 (surveillance CT 0/32), DR 0/5,627 (referral loops 0/233, referral recall 0.894), breast 0/338 (recall loops 0/23), LDCT 0/1,413 (action loops 0/121, recall 0.981), IFHAS 0/3,392 (follow-up loops 0/1,047, recall 0.906). Wrong-patient messages 0/16,486, sent without consent 0/11,650; KPI error 0.031 vs EID-only 0.207; reviewer time 11.6 h per 1k loops across the changed programme mix; hand-off packets 300/300 CRC, 21/21 lung, 35/35 DR. Programme-standardised origin ratio 1.07 (p = 0.185); age-band 1.07, sex 1.03. LDCT/IFHAS generators reuse development texts, so their reader results are not independent generalisation evidence. Disclosed post-hoc changes: τ 0.98 → 0.99 after one wrong-patient closure; the day-15 prep decision no longer skips pending histology (4 false closures in the first run at `b53ce89`); surname-variant and Emirates ID identity rules (about 10% less reviewer time, safety unchanged); hand-off packet fixes and two generator truth corrections after a trace of the misses; held-out noise model fix; MTSamples biopsy key correction; short surnames no longer corroborate alone (after 1 wrong-patient message in a run); second-identifier answers reused across a patient's loops; larger cohorts from every held-out person; reader v7.2 ignores upper-GI tissue in combined EGD + colonoscopy reports; a loop messages the patient only about its own programme's events; the diabetic retinopathy loop (readers tuned on one held-out corpus, fair-tested on a second); one link question per registration pair (also removed the held-out sex gap); the origin ratio standardised by programme (dev noise shows a possible CRC gap, 1.08–1.10, p = 0.01–0.06, in identity questions; weak evidence after about 16 subgroup tests); a confirming review before a human 'same' merges records that contradict on sex or birth date (after the Learn-then-Test re-run found one such double-reviewer-error merge); the same confirming review for second-identifier answers; a rejected intake that cites the referral raises a link question (4 missed packets recovered); the contradiction check narrowed to sex only (a trace found the birth-date arm held 675 true matches and caught no wrong merge); the breast loop (readers fair-tested on a held-out corpus by another model family).
evidence.label: simulated

evidence.what: **Clean-review sensitivity** (post-hoc; same five held-out v2 seeds and frozen settings, except both simulated reviewer-error rates set to zero)
evidence.result: CRC P 1.000, **R 0.859 (0.835–0.883)**, **0/3,322 false closures**, versus R 0.785 with reviewer-error stress (**+7.4 pp**). Wrong-patient messages 0/16,534; sent without consent 0/11,610. This makes simulated reviewers agree with simulated truth; it is not measured clinician performance and does not replace the frozen stress result. See `pipeline/results/clean-review-sensitivity/`.
evidence.label: simulated

evidence.result: Fresh normal and x10 scale runs measured zero unexpected linker restarts, wrong-patient releases, false closures, consent violations, duplicate outputs and replay mismatches after the historical failures were fixed; all historical failures remain disclosed. On fresh B8 seeds 17/29 with 2% wrong EIDs, guard-off produced 19 false closures and guard-on produced 0; CRC recall 0.7535 → 0.7420, review 31.9205 → 33.012 items/100 loops. Guard remains default-off; residual linkage contamination remains. See `pipeline/results/scale/` and `pipeline/results/b8-hardening/`. Container runtime was verified only with Podman 5.8.2 using the Docker Compose v5.1.4 provider; Docker Engine and a restarted/retained-volume deployment remain unverified. Static deployment checks passed.

evidence.result: Wrong-EID guard-on had 394/1,527 misses: first barriers were identity/linking 49.5%, simulated reviewer error 26.6%, timing/ungraded prep 11.4%, and model/rule/other 12.4%. No link/no review was the largest category (146); ungraded prep appeared in 241 misses. After excluding 13 guard-off closures using another person's report, net right-patient guard recall cost was 0.26 pp. The split proposal uses new non-evaluation seeds, disjoint people, new text and new noise with locked validation; no training or tuning was implemented. See `pipeline/results/recall-analysis/`.
